id: 02_Basic Electrical Laboratory VTU Familiarization of Meters Ammeters Voltmeters Wa
title: 认识电工实验室的四种仪表
source_doc: course/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/02_Basic Electrical Laboratory VTU Familiarization of Meters Ammeters Voltmeters Wa.md
author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/02_Basic Electrical Laboratory VTU Familiarization of Meters Ammeters Voltmeters Wa/src.py

points.K11: 动圈式与动铁式电压表
points.K13: 电流线圈串、电压线圈并
points.K16: 单位功率因数表与低功率因数表
points.S2: 接错表、用错挡，后果严重
points.S4: 断电接表，教师检查后通电

shots.scene: 欣欣站在仪表柜前，柜里摆着几只指针式电表和一只万用表，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of an instrument cabinet holding several analog meters with blank dials and a multimeter, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课认识电工实验室的四种仪表。
overlay: 认识电工实验室的四种仪表

shots.scene: 电流表、电压表、功率表、万用表四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: an ammeter, a voltmeter, a wattmeter and a multimeter, all with blank dials. No people.
shots.narration: 电流表、电压表、功率表、万用表。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着电流表的两根线，正要直接夹到电源两端
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds two leads from an ammeter and is about to clip them straight across the power supply terminals.
shots.narration: 阿杰想测电流，直接把表接到电源两端。

shots.scene: 电流表跨接电源的图标，冒出火花，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an ammeter connected directly across a power source with a spark, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 这样一通电，表可能当场烧坏。

shots.scene: 小研按住阿杰的手，指着电源开关
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops the young male student's hand and points to the switched-off bench power switch.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：先弄懂这块表怎么接。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 表接对了，读数才准，人和表才安全。

shots.scene: 王老师把四只仪表依次摆在实验台上
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator places four meters one by one on the lab bench.
shots.narration: 做实验之前，先熟悉这四种仪表。

shots.scene: 四只仪表图标连到一块电路板，每只旁边有问号
shots.prompt_en: Four meter icons linked to a circuit board icon, each with a small question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 每种表测什么、怎么接，都要弄清。

shots.scene: 圆圈里一个字母 A 的电流表符号，旁边是指针式电流表
shots.prompt_en: A circuit symbol of a circle with the letter A inside, next to an analog ammeter with a blank dial. No people.
shots.narration: 电流表，用来测电路里的电流。

shots.scene: 导线里流动的小箭头，汇入电流表
shots.prompt_en: Small arrows flowing along a wire into an ammeter icon. No people.
shots.narration: 单位是安培，所以也叫安培表。

shots.scene: 电池、电流表、负载首尾相连成一圈
shots.prompt_en: A circuit icon: a battery, an ammeter and a load connected end to end in a single loop. No people.
shots.narration: 电流表要串联在电路里。

shots.scene: 箭头依次穿过电池、电流表、负载
shots.prompt_en: Arrows passing in turn through the battery, the ammeter and the load in a single loop. No people.
shots.narration: 被测电流全部从表里流过。

shots.scene: 电流表内部一个很小的电阻图标
shots.prompt_en: An ammeter icon with a cutaway showing a very small resistor inside. No people.
shots.narration: 所以电流表的内阻做得很小。

shots.scene: 电流表两端只有很小的电压降，负载上电压基本不变
shots.prompt_en: An icon showing a tiny voltage drop arrow across the ammeter and a large one across the load. No people.
shots.narration: 表上压降小，才不影响原电路。

shots.scene: 两只电流表并排：一只表盘有直线符号，一只有波浪符号
shots.prompt_en: Two analog ammeters side by side: one marked with a straight line symbol, the other with a wave symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 电流表分直流和交流两种。

shots.scene: 直流表内部是可动线圈，交流表内部是铁片
shots.prompt_en: Two cutaway icons: a moving coil inside one meter, a moving iron vane inside the other. No people.
shots.narration: 直流用动圈式，交流用动铁式。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着直线和波浪两个符号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a straight line symbol and a wave symbol on a blank card.
shots.narration: 直线是直流，波浪是交流。

shots.scene: 一只电流表上三个接线柱，其中一个标为公共端
shots.prompt_en: An analog ammeter with three terminals on top, one of them highlighted as the common terminal. No people.
shots.narration: 双量程表：公共端固定，另一端选量程。

shots.scene: 表盘上有上下两条刻度，大量程连到上刻度
shots.prompt_en: A meter dial with an upper scale and a lower scale; an arrow links the higher range terminal to the upper scale. No people.
shots.narration: 接大量程，看上刻度。

shots.scene: 小量程接线柱连到下刻度
shots.prompt_en: The same dial; an arrow links the lower range terminal to the lower scale. No people.
shots.narration: 接小量程，看下刻度。

shots.scene: 阿杰盯着表盘皱眉，小研指向正确的刻度
shots.prompt_en: The young male student frowns at a meter dial; the female graduate student points to the correct scale.
shots.narration: 很多人读错刻度，现在就要分清。

shots.scene: 一根粗导线和一根细导线并排，粗的接到电流表
shots.prompt_en: A thick wire and a thin wire side by side; the thick wire is connected to an ammeter. No people.
shots.narration: 电流表串在主回路，导线要能通过回路电流。

shots.scene: 老周查看导线和表上的额定标志
shots.prompt_en: The older man checks the wire thickness against the rating mark on a meter.
shots.narration: 导线粗细，按回路电流和实验室规定选。

shots.scene: 圆圈里一个字母 V 的电压表符号，旁边是电压表
shots.prompt_en: A circuit symbol of a circle with the letter V inside, next to an analog voltmeter with a blank dial. No people.
shots.narration: 电压表，测的是两点间的电压。

shots.scene: 电压表内部一个很大的电阻图标
shots.prompt_en: A voltmeter icon with a cutaway showing a very large resistor inside. No people.
shots.narration: 它的内阻做得很大。

shots.scene: 流过电压表的电流箭头极细
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a voltmeter with only a hair-thin current arrow flowing through it. No people.
shots.narration: 这样几乎不分走电流，不改变电路。

shots.scene: 电压表的两根线跨接在电阻两端
shots.prompt_en: A circuit icon: a battery, a resistor and a load in a loop, with a voltmeter connected across the two ends of the resistor. No people.
shots.narration: 电压表要并联在被测元件两端。

shots.scene: 小研把电压表并接在电阻两端（电源已断开）
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student connects a voltmeter across a resistor on a switched-off circuit board.
shots.narration: 比如测电阻两端的电压降。

shots.scene: 两张对照卡：电流表串联、电压表并联
shots.prompt_en: Two comparison cards: an ammeter in series in a loop, and a voltmeter connected in parallel across a resistor. No people.
shots.narration: 记住：电流表串，电压表并。

shots.scene: 一棵分类树图标，分出三根枝
shots.prompt_en: A tree diagram icon branching into three blank boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 电压表可以从三个角度分类。

shots.scene: 指针表和数字表并排
shots.prompt_en: An analog voltmeter with a needle next to a digital voltmeter with a blank display. No people.
shots.narration: 按显示，分模拟式和数字式。

shots.scene: 五个不同结构的表芯小图标
shots.prompt_en: Five small cutaway icons of different meter movements in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 按结构，有整流式、动铁式、动圈式等。

shots.scene: 直线和波浪两个符号被高亮
shots.prompt_en: A straight line symbol and a wave symbol highlighted with a glow. No people.
shots.narration: 实验中最常用的是分交流、直流。

shots.section_title: 动圈式与动铁式电压表
shots.scene: 直流电压表和交流电压表并排
shots.prompt_en: A DC voltmeter and an AC voltmeter side by side, dials blank except for the line and wave symbols. No people.
shots.narration: 直流电压表是动圈式，交流是动铁式。
overlay: 动圈式与动铁式电压表

shots.section_title: 动圈式与动铁式电压表
shots.scene: 电压表的两个量程接线柱分别连向上、下刻度
shots.prompt_en: A voltmeter with two range terminals, arrows linking each terminal to the upper or lower scale. No people.
shots.narration: 电压表也要按所接量程读刻度。

shots.scene: 功率表实物和一个灯泡
shots.prompt_en: An analog wattmeter with a blank dial next to a glowing light bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 功率表测的是有功功率。

shots.scene: 有功功率的柱子亮起，无功功率的柱子变灰
shots.prompt_en: Two bars: one labeled with a lit bulb icon glowing, the other with a coil icon greyed out. No people.
shots.narration: 无功功率，它不测。

shots.section_title: 电流线圈串、电压线圈并
shots.scene: 功率表内部两个线圈：一个粗线圈、一个细线圈
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway icon of a wattmeter with two coils inside: a thick current coil and a fine voltage coil. No people.
shots.narration: 功率表里有两个线圈。
overlay: 电流线圈串、电压线圈并

shots.section_title: 电流线圈串、电压线圈并
shots.scene: 电流线圈串在负载回路，电压线圈跨接负载两端
shots.prompt_en: A circuit icon: the current coil in series with the load, the voltage coil connected across the load. No people.
shots.narration: 电流线圈串联，电压线圈并联。

shots.section_title: 电流线圈串、电压线圈并
shots.scene: 电流符号乘电压符号等于功率符号
shots.prompt_en: An icon equation: a current arrow times a voltage arrow equals a light bulb with rays. No people.
shots.narration: 电流乘电压，就得到功率。

shots.scene: 功率表顶部四个接线柱，旁边四个字母
shots.prompt_en: The top of an analog wattmeter with four terminals, each with a small blank tag. No people.
shots.narration: 功率表有四个接线端。

shots.scene: M 和 C 两个接线柱之间连一根短线
shots.prompt_en: A short jumper wire connecting two of the four wattmeter terminals. No people.
shots.narration: M 和 C 两端要用短线连起来。

shots.scene: 旋钮和接线柱分别对应电压量程和电流量程
shots.prompt_en: The wattmeter's range terminals highlighted: one group for voltage range, one group for current range. No people.
shots.narration: 电压、电流量程，按实验需要选。

shots.scene: 一张空白卡片上写着 K 的公式图示
shots.prompt_en: A blank card showing a fraction icon: voltage times current times power factor over a full dial. No people.
shots.narration: 用功率表，先算功率表常数 K。

shots.scene: 表盘读数乘以 K 得到功率
shots.prompt_en: An icon: a meter dial reading arrow, a multiply sign, the letter K, an equals sign and a light bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 读到的格数乘 K，才是实际功率。

shots.section_title: 单位功率因数表与低功率因数表
shots.scene: 两只功率表并排，一只贴绿色标签，一只贴橙色标签
shots.prompt_en: Two analog wattmeters side by side, one with a blank green tag and one with a blank orange tag. No people.
shots.narration: 功率表有两种：单位功率因数和低功率因数。
overlay: 单位功率因数表与低功率因数表

shots.section_title: 单位功率因数表与低功率因数表
shots.scene: 电阻负载连绿色表，线圈类负载连橙色表
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a resistor heater linked to the green-tagged meter, and a coil-type load linked to the orange-tagged meter. No people.
shots.narration: 按负载的功率因数来选表。

shots.section_title: 单位功率因数表与低功率因数表
shots.scene: 选错表时表盘指针只偏一点点的图标
shots.prompt_en: A wattmeter dial whose needle barely moves from zero, with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 选错了，读数就不准。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一只数字万用表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a digital multimeter with a blank display.
shots.narration: 万用表，一只表能测好几样。

shots.scene: 电压、电流、电阻、温度、晶体管五个图标围着万用表
shots.prompt_en: Five icons around a multimeter: a voltage arrow, a current arrow, a resistor, a thermometer and a transistor. No people.
shots.narration: 电压、电流、电阻，有的还能测更多。

shots.scene: 指针式万用表和数字万用表并排
shots.prompt_en: An analog multimeter with a needle and a digital multimeter with a blank display side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 万用表分指针式和数字式两种。

shots.scene: 数字万用表正面特写：屏幕、按键、旋钮
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a digital multimeter front: blank display, two small buttons and a big rotary switch. No people.
shots.narration: 上面是显示屏、保持键和电源键。

shots.scene: 旋钮周围一圈挡位图标
shots.prompt_en: A rotary switch surrounded by small icons: straight line, wave, resistor, sound wave for continuity, and a transistor. No people.
shots.narration: 旋钮选挡：电压、电流、电阻、通断。

shots.scene: 表笔测一根导线两端，万用表发出提示音
shots.prompt_en: A multimeter's probes touching both ends of a disconnected wire, with a sound wave icon from the meter. No people.
shots.narration: 通断挡能查导线是否导通。

shots.scene: 表身下方几个插孔，大电流插孔单独一个
shots.prompt_en: The bottom of a multimeter with several jacks; one separate jack highlighted for high current. No people.
shots.narration: 大电流有单独的插孔，别插错。

shots.scene: 一条正弦波，峰值和有效值两条横线
shots.prompt_en: A sine wave icon with two horizontal lines: one at the peak, one lower at the effective value. No people.
shots.narration: 仪表读到的是有效值。

shots.scene: 有效值乘根号二箭头指向峰值
shots.prompt_en: An icon: the lower line, a multiply sign with a square root of two symbol, and an arrow up to the peak line. No people.
shots.narration: 正弦量的峰值，是有效值乘根号二。

shots.scene: 一红一黑两根表笔插在万用表上
shots.prompt_en: A red and a black test lead plugged into a multimeter, laid neatly on the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 万用表通过两根表笔接入电路。

shots.scene: 阿杰翻着空白笔记本复习仪表图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reviews a blank notebook with meter icons drawn on it.
shots.narration: 做实验时，回头看看这一课。

shots.scene: 阿杰举手提问，王老师回应
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand and the safety administrator answers him.
shots.narration: 有疑问，及时问老师。

shots.scene: 量程旋钮转到最大挡的图标，打勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a range selector turned to its highest setting with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 不知道大小，先用最大量程。

shots.scene: 指针从大量程逐步换到合适量程的三个小表盘
shots.prompt_en: Three small dials in a row showing the needle moving from a tiny deflection to a comfortable mid-scale reading. No people.
shots.narration: 断电换挡，再逐步换到合适量程。

shots.scene: 指针打到头和反向偏转两个图标，旁边是断电开关
shots.prompt_en: Two dial icons: a needle slammed past full scale and a needle deflecting backwards, next to a power switch turned off. No people.
shots.narration: 指针打满或反偏，立即断电检查。

shots.section_title: 接错表、用错挡，后果严重
shots.scene: 电流表并在电源两端的图标，冒火花，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an ammeter wired across a power source with sparks, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电流表绝不能并在电源两端。
overlay: 接错表、用错挡，后果严重

shots.section_title: 接错表、用错挡，后果严重
shots.scene: 电流表内阻很小，并上去等于短路
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a short-circuit path through a tiny resistor, with a big current arrow and heat waves. No people.
shots.narration: 它内阻很小，接错就等于短路。

shots.section_title: 接错表、用错挡，后果严重
shots.scene: 万用表在电流挡、表笔去测插座的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a multimeter set to the current range with probes going to a wall socket, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电流挡、电阻挡，不能去测电压。

shots.section_title: 接错表、用错挡，后果严重
shots.scene: 表笔离开电路后再转动旋钮
shots.prompt_en: An icon of probes lifted away from a circuit board, then a hand turning the rotary switch. No people.
shots.narration: 换挡前，表笔先离开电路。

shots.section_title: 接错表、用错挡，后果严重
shots.scene: 测电阻前先拉下电源开关
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power switch turned off before the probes touch a resistor. No people.
shots.narration: 测电阻，一定先断电。

shots.scene: 老李查看表笔，发现一根绝缘层开裂
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects test leads and finds one with cracked insulation.
shots.narration: 用表前，先看表笔和导线有没有破损。

shots.scene: 破损表笔放进空白的待修盒
shots.prompt_en: The damaged test lead is placed into a blank repair box. No people.
shots.narration: 破了、裂了，就换掉，不凑合用。

shots.scene: 手握表笔，手指在护指环后面
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a hand holding a test probe with fingers behind the finger guard. No people.
shots.narration: 测量时，手指放在护指环后面。

shots.scene: 仪表外壳破裂的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a meter with a cracked case, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 表壳破了的仪表，停止使用。

shots.section_title: 断电接表，教师检查后通电
shots.scene: 阿杰先拉下实验台开关，再接电流表和电压表
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off the bench power first, then connects an ammeter and a voltmeter on the circuit board.
shots.narration: 接表、改接、拆表，都要先断电。
overlay: 断电接表，教师检查后通电

shots.section_title: 断电接表，教师检查后通电
shots.scene: 王老师对照电路图检查电流表是否串联、电压表是否并联
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks the circuit against a blank diagram, tracing the ammeter in series and the voltmeter in parallel.
shots.narration: 接好后，请老师查表的接法和量程。

shots.section_title: 断电接表，教师检查后通电
shots.scene: 王老师点头后，阿杰合上开关
shots.prompt_en: After the safety administrator nods, the young male student switches the bench power on.
shots.narration: 老师同意了，才能通电读数。

shots.section_title: 断电接表，教师检查后通电
shots.scene: 通电时伸手去拔导线的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand pulling a wire from a powered circuit, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 通电时不碰接线柱，不带电改线。

shots.scene: 一只电表冒出细烟
shots.prompt_en: Thin smoke rises from an analog meter on a circuit board. No people.
shots.narration: 表冒烟、发烫、有焦味？

shots.scene: 小研立刻拉下实验台电源开关
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student immediately switches off the bench power switch.
shots.narration: 第一步，立即切断电源。

shots.scene: 向冒烟仪表泼水的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of water thrown onto a smoking meter, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 带电设备着火，不能用水浇。

shots.scene: 老李用二氧化碳灭火器对准小火
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer aims a carbon dioxide extinguisher at a small fire on the bench.
shots.narration: 小火用干粉或二氧化碳灭火器。

shots.scene: 火势变大，众人撤离，保卫处值班员打电话
shots.prompt_en: The fire grows; everyone leaves under an exit sign while the security officer calls on a phone.
shots.narration: 控制不住就撤离，拨打 119。

shots.scene: 阿杰触电倒在台边，小研冲去拉下总闸
shots.prompt_en: The young male student slumps beside the bench after an electric shock; the female graduate student rushes to pull the main switch.
shots.narration: 有人触电，先切断电源。

shots.scene: 徒手拉人的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand grabbing a person being shocked, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 断电前，不能徒手去拉。

shots.scene: 老周拨打电话，老李在旁照护
shots.prompt_en: The older man calls on a mobile phone with a blank screen while the facility engineer, trained in first aid, attends to the young male student.
shots.narration: 拨打 120，受过培训的人施救。

shots.scene: 小研向王老师报告，保卫处值班员记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the safety administrator while the security officer writes on a blank clipboard.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人、学院和保卫处。

shots.scene: 四只仪表图标，各标串联或并联
shots.prompt_en: Four meter icons: ammeter with a series loop, voltmeter with a parallel link, wattmeter with two coils, multimeter with a rotary switch. No people.
shots.narration: 电流表串，电压表并，功率表两样都有。

shots.scene: 量程、刻度、常数 K 三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a range selector, an upper and lower scale, and the letter K. No people.
shots.narration: 选对量程，读对刻度，别忘乘 K。

shots.scene: 断电开关、老师检查、灭火器三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a switched-off power switch, a teacher checking a circuit, and a fire extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 断电接表，查过再通电，异常先断电。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整齐的仪表柜前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of a tidy instrument cabinet with meters lined up.
shots.narration: 会用仪表，安全测量，下次见！
